openTuiStartup.description: Linux x64 OpenTUI startup gate for lando --version, covering end-to-end startup and time to first output at p95.

landofileLoad.description: Warm in-process loadLandofileLayers on the pre-decode-once integration base; tracing disabled, three warmups, median and nearest-rank p95 in milliseconds.

toolingHotPath.description: Linux x64 hot-path benchmark gate for lando <tooling-alias>. The target is 150 ms warm p95; the tracked 900 ms current baseline documents the present compiled-binary host-tooling warm path and must be reviewed when changed.

redaction.description: Linux x64 in-process redaction gate over a deterministic 10k-line mixed log: complete-text redaction (mixed, trigger-free, trigger-heavy, sparse-secret, and adversarial text), the bounded line-stream, the live channel, command-result envelope encoding, and MCP bounded JSON. Three warmups, 60 timed runs; median is the median of three baseline executions and p95 is the highest nearest-rank p95 of the three, so host jitter on a stable tree does not trip the cap. Main-comparable cases were re-measured from three origin/main executions on the same host as this entry. Cases with no origin/main API (the live channel) record their first branch measurement; the adversarial cases have no main comparator because origin/main does not complete a pass over that text (its percent-encoded userinfo regex is superlinear, about 4.7 s per redactString pass).
